tiktok.caption:
This task takes 30 minutes. I've avoided it for three days. 🫠

Day 1: I'll do it after lunch. Day 2: I opened it, then closed it. Day 3: the guilt is worse than the task. And it's client feedback.

So I told FOCO about it. It broke it into four tiny steps. Step 1 was just reading her email once. Three minutes, something chill on, and I was actually doing it.

What task have you been avoiding? 👇
Save this for the next time you're stuck 📌

You don't need another to-do list. You need help starting. The app on the slides is FOCO, link in bio 💜
